info.name: Nath Mandir — Mobile API
info.description:
Mobile app API for the Shreenath Gitanjali app (drop-in replacement for the legacy API.php), now including CONTENT delivery.

## How it works
Every operation goes to a single endpoint:

`POST {{baseUrl}}/api/mobile?apicall=<operation>`

Parameters are sent as **x-www-form-urlencoded** body fields (GET + query params also work — the server reads `req.body[key] ?? req.query[key]`).

## The model ("Spotify model")
The devotee **pays on the website** (`/subscribe`) with a mobile number. The backend verifies Razorpay **server-side** and sets an unlock **flag** on that user. The **app sells nothing** — it logs in with the **same number**, reads the flags, and plays the songs of the modules that are unlocked.

## Entitlement flags (on the user object; 1 = owned, 0 = locked)
| Module | code | Flag field |
|---|---|---|
| Gitanjali Part 1 | gita1 | `Part_1` |
| Gitanjali Part 2 | gita2 | `Part_2` |
| Upasana Part | upasana | `upasanaPaid` |
| Nityaniyam Part | nithya | `nityaniyamPaid` |

## Auth
- **Public (no token):** `loginuser`, `verifyOTP`, `register`, `admin_login`
- **Protected (Bearer token):** everything else → `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

The token is a **mobile JWT** issued by `verifyOTP` and stored on the user row. Logging in on another device invalidates old tokens. Separate from admin-panel auth.

## Quick start
1. Run **register** once (if the number is new).
2. Run **loginuser** → OTP returned in the response (legacy) and auto-saved to `{{otp}}`.
3. Run **verifyOTP** → JWT auto-saved to `{{token}}` and used by all protected requests.
4. Run **home** → modules with owned flag; **get_content** → songs of a module.

> Test account: mobile `1234567890` always gets OTP `1947`.

## Response shape
All responses return `{ "status": <code>, "error": "true"|"false", "message": "..." }` plus optional `data` / `otp` / `token` / `modules` / `content`. Note `error` is a **string**, not a boolean.

request.description: Send an OTP to a REGISTERED mobile number (else 404 'Please Register First'). The OTP is echoed in the response (legacy). Test number 1234567890 always gets 1947.
Create a devotee account. name, email, mobile required. 409 if the mobile already exists.
Verify OTP and log in. Returns a JWT (token) + the full user object with the entitlement flags. DID = device id (binds this device; other devices logged out).

item.name: Gallery (no token)
item.description: Photo gallery (छायाचित्रे) for the app. Public — no Bearer token needed. Only albums the admin marked Published are returned, and every image url is an absolute URL ready for an Image widget.

item.name: gallery — published albums + flat photo list

request.description:
One call gives both shapes the gallery screen needs:
- albums[] — album/category listing
- photos[] — one flat list for the top carousel and the grid

Optional params: category (default all), page + limit (omit both to get every photo).

item.name: gallery_album — one album with its photos

request.description: Album detail screen. 400 when id is missing/not a number, 404 when the album does not exist or is unpublished.

item.name: home — modules + owned flag + song counts

request.description: Home screen for the logged-in user: all 4 modules with name, price, whether THIS user owns it (owned), and how many published songs it has (songCount). Drive locked/unlocked UI from `owned`.

response.name: 200 — modules

request.description:
Songs of a module. `product` = module code (gita1 | gita2 | upasana | nithya).
When the user OWNS it: owned=true and each item has a full playable audioUrl + lyrics.
type is 'audio' (has audioUrl) or 'text' (lyrics only). Render by sortOrder.

response.name: 200 — owned (full audio + lyrics)

request.description: When the user does NOT own the module: owned=false, titles still listed (locked=true) but audioUrl & lyrics are withheld (null). App shows a locked state — NO price, NO buy button, NO website link (app-store reader-app rule).

response.name: 200 — locked (media withheld)

item.name: subscribed_items — main items the user has subscribed to

request.description: List ONLY the main items (modules/products) the logged-in user has subscribed to. Same shape as `home` but filters out locked modules. Each entry has code, name, price, and itemCount (published sub-items inside).

item.name: sub_items — detailed list of sub-items of a subscribed module

request.description: Detailed list of the sub-items (Content rows) inside a subscribed module. `product` = module code (gita1 | gita2 | upasana | nithya). Returns metadata only — no media URL. Call `get_media` when the user taps an item to fetch the playable URL. Returns 403 if the module is NOT subscribed.

response.name: 200 — sub items

item.name: get_media — media file for a tapped item

request.description: Called when the user taps an item in the sub-items list. `id` = content id. Returns absolute audioUrl + lyrics — but only if the caller has subscribed to the parent module (else 403).

item.name: mark_played — +1 play count for a song

request.description: Call when a song actually starts playing (optional; feeds admin analytics). id = content id. Only counts if the user owns the song's module, else 403.

response.name: 403 — module not unlocked

request.description: Re-fetch the user (fresh Part_1 / Part_2 / upasanaPaid / nityaniyamPaid). Call on app open/resume and pull-to-refresh so a website purchase unlocks WITHOUT reinstall.

item.name: receipts — paid receipts for a user

request.description: Successful payments for a user (id = user id). Returns amount, status, dates, payment_type.

item.name: check_active_session — is this device still logged in?

request.description: Success if THIS device (DID) is still the active session; 401 'Is Logged Out' if logged in elsewhere.
Log the user out from all devices.
No apicall param -> 400 Invalid API Call.
Any authenticated apicall without a valid Bearer token -> 401.
